To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) AutoShim docking can be used to predict kinase affinities with a correlation of r 2 0.8, and (2) the ensemble surrogate AutoShim method can be used to build kinase models without a crystal structure, with a correlation of 0.7, and (3), the entire Novartis archive can be virtually screened into a kinase model, with a 10% enrichment of active compounds, in hours.

(a) AutoShim is a docking method that gives good correlations with experimental IC50 data; (b) Surrogate AutoShims, built from a single kinase crystal structure and adjusted to reproduce IC50 data for a new kinase target, give good correlations with IC50 data; and (c) Ensemble surrogate AutoShims, which are predocked into a universal ensemble kinase receptor, and which use only 10,000 kinase-biased compounds from a corporate screening collection, give good

(1) the kinase binding site is highly conserved, (2) the conserved site can be modeled by an ensemble of crystal structures, (3) a universal kinase receptor can be constructed from the ensemble by a set of shims, (4) the shims can be optimized for each new kinase target using a PLS procedure, and (5) this procedure gives a fast, accurate, and general method for kinase docking.
In summary, our research is concerned with
three dimensional (3D) activity prediction.
developing new computational methods to accelerate drug discovery, by predicting the activity of a compound on a new target, based on the activity on a different target.
the application of computational methods in the design of novel therapeutic agents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the surrogate AutoShim method is a practical and efficient way to build a new kinase target model, without requiring a crystal structure.
the surrogate ensemble AutoShim method has been shown to be a viable alternative to the original AutoShim method.
surrogate AutoShim is a new and powerful tool for the rapid design of kinase ligands.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
surrogate AutoShim is a new, very fast, and accurate, 3D QSAR technique for kinase lead discovery.
we have solved the three traditional limitations that have prevented conventional docking from being a useful tool in drug discovery.
AutoShim is a new paradigm for kinase modeling.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the ensemble receptor can be trained for any kinase target by using only 100-300 IC 50 values, so that new kinase models can then be built and screened against the corporate compound collection, without waiting for a new crystal structure to be solved.
, for any given kinase target, a single crystal structure binding site can be shimmed to reproduce the binding affinities of compounds to any other kinase target.
, with a few hundred experimental IC 5 values, a kinase model can be built, in hours, that can be used to predict activity of a large corporate compound archive in a few hours.
